noDownstream: {count} changed symbol(s), no downstream callers found.
unattributed: Endpoints in caller files (not attributed to a symbol)
withoutCallers: {count, plural, one {# more changed symbol has} other {# more changed symbols have}} no callers.
callersOmitted: {count, plural, one {# more caller is} other {# more callers are}} not shown (top callers per symbol, by file rank).

degraded.flag_off: Repo intelligence is turned off on the server (REPO_INTEL_ENABLED=false). Callers come from a best-effort text search and may be incomplete.
degraded.no_data: This repository has no code index yet, so callers can't be mapped. The index is built after the repository is cloned.
degraded.index_partial: The code index is partial — some callers may be missing.
degraded.index_failed: The last indexing run failed — callers may be missing or outdated.
degraded.repo_too_large: The repository is too large to index fully — callers may be missing.

resync.hint: Resync fetches the latest default branch and rebuilds the index; this map refreshes when it finishes.
resync.timeout: Resync is still running — reload this page in a minute.

graph.truncated: {count, plural, one {# more node is} other {# more nodes are}} not shown — switch to Tree for the full list.
graph.cronsHint: Crons are listed in the Tree view.

toggle.expand: Expand {symbol}, {count, plural, one {# caller} other {# callers}}
toggle.collapse: Collapse {symbol}, {count, plural, one {# caller} other {# callers}}

prior.title: Prior PRs touching these files
prior.countAria: {count, plural, one {# prior PR} other {# prior PRs}}
prior.empty: No earlier PR in this repository touched these files.
prior.sharedFiles: {count, plural, one {# shared file} other {# shared files}}
prior.more: {count, plural, one {# more earlier PR} other {# more earlier PRs}} not shown.
